data.title: Benzinga Announces 2026 Benzinga Awards
data.description:
Benzinga Announces 2026 Benzinga Awards

Benzinga Announces 2026 Benzinga Awards

PR Newswire

DETROIT, Oct. 16, 2026

DETROIT, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Benzinga announced the Benzinga Awards 2026 today, a digital awards program recognizing leading companies, innovators and professionals across financial services and fintech.

The 2026 program, which is judged in collaboration with DALBAR, will highlight organizations helping shape the future of financial technology, investing and financial services across a range of award categories.

"We are honored to partner with Benzinga and contribute DALBAR's independent research, analytical rigor, and industry expertise to the evaluation process for these prestigious awards," said Steve Worthy, Managing Director of DALBAR. "By helping assess nominees against objective standards of excellence, innovation, and client impact, we are proud to support the recognition of organizations and leaders who are setting the benchmark for achievement across the financial services industry."

The digital awards program will culminate in an in-person celebration on November 19, 2026, at Ascent Lounge, 10 Columbus Circle, 4th Floor, New York, NY 10019. The event will bring together award winners, sponsors and industry leaders for an evening celebrating this year's honorees.

"This is our 12th year running the Benzinga Awards, and the field has never been harder to judge," said Andrew Lebbos, SVP of Licensing at Benzinga. "A dozen years ago most of these companies didn't exist. We are bringing everyone into one room in Manhattan for a night to recognize the people building the future of finance!"

Interested applicants can apply here: https://www.benzinga.com/fintech-awards#apply

The awards submission portal is open until October 23, 2026, 11:59 PM Eastern. Costs to apply are $250.00 per single award, or $500.00 for unlimited award submissions per company.

"Benzinga started as a newsroom, and over twelve years we have become something closer to infrastructure. The same real-time news, analyst ratings and corporate event data that millions of retail investors read on our site now flows through our APIs into brokerages, trading platforms and AI systems across the industry," said Dave Maher, CEO and CTO of Benzinga. "These awards matter to us because we work alongside many of the honorees every day. Recognizing the companies that are rebuilding how people access and act on financial information is a natural extension of what Benzinga does."

Winners will be announced ahead of the November celebration.

To apply to the Benzinga Awards 2026 program, click here.

For more information about the event or sponsorship opportunities, please visit https://www.benzinga.com/fintech-awards.

About Benzinga

Benzinga is a leading financial media and data technology company that empowers investors with high-quality, real-time market intelligence. Through its news platform, APIs, and data products, Benzinga provides traders, financial institutions, and fintech platforms with the insights they need to make smarter investment decisions. From breaking news and analyst ratings to corporate events and alternative datasets, Benzinga's tools help market participants stay ahead of the information that drives price movement.

To learn more, visit www.benzinga.com.

data.title: Vail Turns Up the Volume, Unveils First Wave of Artists for Its Biggest Music Season Yet
data.description:
Vail Turns Up the Volume, Unveils First Wave of Artists for Its Biggest Music Season Yet

Vail Turns Up the Volume, Unveils First Wave of Artists for Its Biggest Music Season Yet

PR Newswire

VAIL, Colo., Oct. 16, 2026

ILLENIUM and Ian Asher kick off Vail's biggest music season yet, alongside seven on-mountain performances and two brand-new venues

VAIL, Colo., Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- With the first snowfall on Vail Mountain's peaks this week and snowmaking kicked off last night, anticipation for winter is building fast. This season, Vail is raising the bar with its most ambitious music lineup yet, bringing more live music, more venues and more unforgettable performances to the mountain and village than ever before.

Headliners and New Venues
Kicking off the season on December 11, GRAMMY®-nominated, multi-platinum artist ILLENIUM will headline a marquee performance at the new Dobson Arena, ushering in a winter packed with music experiences designed for the mountains. With the potential for surprise performances throughout the weekend, fans will want to keep a close eye on social media at @VailMtn for artist announcements and unexpected moments.

On January 16, Southern California DJ, producer and remix sensation Ian Asher takes over Dobson Arena. Best known for his viral electronic and house remixes, including the billion-stream "Makeba" remix that earned Remix of the Year honors, Asher represents the next generation of dance music talent and expands Vail's growing lineup of nationally recognized artists.

Freshly transformed into a premier entertainment venue, Dobson Arena combines more than 56,000 square feet of state-of-the-art production capabilities with unmistakable alpine character, creating a concert experience unlike any other in the Rockies.

"There's nothing quite like live music in the mountains, and we're excited to bring even more of it to Vail this winter," said Shaydar Edelmann, vice president and chief operating officer of Vail Mountain. "Working alongside the Town of Vail and our community partners, we're creating more opportunities for guests to come together and enjoy incredible music in a legendary setting."

This winter builds on a breakout 2025/26 season, when Vail hosted on-mountain performances from globally recognized artists including SOFI TUKKER, Dillon Francis, Chris Lorenzo and John Summit. Always dreaming bigger, Vail is expanding its music footprint even further with seven on-mountain performances, three more than last season, plus two brand-new music venues.

Following the success of last season's first-ever sunrise concert beneath the Legendary Back Bowls sign, Vail is once again pushing the boundaries of what an alpine music experience can be. Additional artists, venues and mountain activations will be unveiled throughout the season, giving fans new reasons to visit and new ways to experience music at elevation. Announcements will be released throughout the winter on @VailMtn.

Vail Après Scene
As Vail's live music lineup grows, so does the experience surrounding it. This winter, the destination will pair headline performances and on-mountain sets with a robust lineup of après events, culinary offerings and nightlife experiences throughout the village.

  • NEW! The Vail Ice Bar: A beloved Vail tradition returns. Located next to the Legendary Back Bowls Gate, the reimagined Vail Ice Bar blends alpine nostalgia with a lively outdoor gathering space for drinks, music and après in the heart of Vail Mountain. See images of the historic Vail Ice Bar HERE.
  • Après All Day at Express Lift (base of Gondola One, starting opening day): More than 50 performing artists, nearly double last season with live DJs every Friday, Saturday and Sunday, 2:30–5:30 p.m., in collaboration with Vail Mountain partner Outer Range Brewing. See full schedule HERE. 
  • Chasing Rabbits: When the lifts stop spinning, the night is just getting started. The Rabbit Hole returns with high-energy DJ sets and unforgettable winter nights, following performances by Loud Luxury, Dombresky and Chris Lorenzo. This winter's lineup, coming soon, already includes a Coachella headliner, a Billboard Music Awards nominee and internationally recognized DJs.
  • Stoke Sessions: Live Music every Friday for the first month of the ski season in Vail. Bundle up, sip something warm, and celebrate the season with the Vail community. Lineup Announcement coming soon! Follow @discovervailcolorado to be the first to know.

Epic Passes on Sale for the 2026/27 Winter Season
Epic Passes are on sale now and with new savings for young adults, skiers and riders ages 13-30 can save 20% on an Epic Pass or Epic Local Pass. Plus, guests who purchase an Epic Pass or Epic Local Pass now will receive five Epic Friend Tickets offering 50% off adult lift tickets, making it easier to bring the crew along and save. Epic Friend Tickets can also be used for 25% off child lift ticket prices.

About Vail Mountain
Vail Mountain spans more than 5,300 acres of terrain, including the Legendary Back Bowls and Blue Sky Basin. Founded in 1962, Vail is one of the world's premier mountain destinations and a part of the Vail Resorts network connected by the Epic Pass. For more information, visit Vail.com.

data.title: AM Best Affirms Credit Ratings of China Taiping Insurance (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.
data.description:
AM Best Affirms Credit Ratings of China Taiping Insurance (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.

AM Best has affirmed the Financial Strength Rating of A (Excellent) and the Long-Term Issuer Credit Rating of “a” (Excellent) of China Taiping Insurance (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. (CTPIS) (Singapore). The outlook of these Credit Ratings (ratings) is stable. CTPIS is a wholly owned subsidiary of China Taiping Insurance Holdings Company Limited, which is ultimately majority owned by China Taiping Insurance Group Ltd. (TPG), a China state-owned financial and insurance group.

The ratings reflect CTPIS’ balance sheet strength, which AM Best assesses as strong, as well as its adequate operating performance, neutral business profile and appropriate enterprise risk management (ERM). In addition, CTPIS benefits from rating enhancement as a member of the TPG group.

CTPIS’ balance sheet strength is underpinned by risk-adjusted capitalisation, which is expected to remain at the strongest level over the intermediate term, as measured by Best’s Capital Adequacy Ratio (BCAR). Additionally, CTPIS benefits from strong financial flexibility as demonstrated by capital injections provided by the TPG group in recent years to support the development of its life insurance operations. The company’s investment portfolio consists of cash, deposits and fixed-income securities, albeit with some exposure to higher-risk asset classes such as equities. CTPIS has a moderate reinsurance usage to support the underwriting of large limit risks and life insurance products; however, the credit risk is partially mitigated by the company’s utilisation of a well-rated reinsurance panel.

CTPIS’ operating performance is assessed as adequate, with a return-on-equity ratio of 6% in 2025 (2024: 5.8%). The 2025 operating income was mainly supported by profitable non-life business, while the life business showed improvement during the year. Operating performance remained profitable in the first half of 2026. CTPIS’ investment income is comprised mainly of interest and dividend income and continues to support overall profitability.

AM Best assesses CTPIS’ business profile as neutral. The company is a medium-size composite insurer, domiciled in Singapore, with a long-established position within that country’s non-life segment and an increasing position in the life segment. CTPIS maintains a well-diversified underwriting portfolio, with life insurance operations contributing approximately half of gross premiums written in 2025, albeit the portfolio is geographically concentrated in Singapore. The company benefits from its affiliation with the TPG group, which provides it a level of preferential access to insured risks associated with China-based enterprises in the Singapore market.

The rating enhancement reflects both the implicit and explicit support CTPIS receives from the TPG group. While CTPIS’ operations account for a small portion of the group’s consolidated revenue and earnings, it is considered strategically important to the group in terms of accessing the Singapore insurance market and growing its overseas business.

Ratings are communicated to rated entities prior to publication. Unless stated otherwise, the ratings were not amended subsequent to that communication.

This press release relates to Credit Ratings that have been published on AM Best’s website. For all rating information relating to the release and pertinent disclosures, including details of the office responsible for issuing each of the individual ratings referenced in this release, please see AM Best’s Recent Rating Activity web page. For additional information regarding the use and limitations of Credit Rating opinions, please view Guide to Best’s Credit Ratings. For information on the proper use of Best’s Credit Ratings, Best’s Performance Assessments, Best’s Preliminary Credit Assessments and AM Best press releases, please view Guide to Proper Use of Best’s Ratings & Assessments.

AM Best is a global credit rating agency, news publisher and data analytics provider specialising in the insurance industry. Headquartered in the United States, the company does business in over 100 countries with regional offices in London, Amsterdam, Dubai, Hong Kong, Singapore and Mexico City. For more information, visit www.ambest.com.

data.title: Nova Compression Names Zach Gray Interim CEO
data.description:
Nova Compression Names Zach Gray Interim CEO

Compression veteran Mike Wright joins as SVP of Business Development; OIC’s Jay McKenna named Interim President

Nova Compression, LLC (“Nova”), an Oklahoma City-based provider of natural gas contract compression services, today announced a series of executive leadership appointments, naming Chief Financial Officer Zach Gray as interim chief executive officer.

Gray succeeds Jonathan Mitchell, who has departed the company. Mitchell had led Nova since January 2020, guiding the company through a period of acquisitions and expansion across Oklahoma and Texas.

“Jonathan helped lead Nova through a period of significant growth, including major acquisitions and expansion into highly productive basins,” said Hale Hoak, Nova board member. “We thank him for his service and wish him well. We’re confident in Zach and in the strength of this team.”

Gray, an oil and gas veteran, has served as Nova’s CFO since May.

“Zach brings more than two decades of leadership experience across energy infrastructure, finance, operations and corporate development, following his service as a U.S. Army officer in the 25th Infantry Division,” said Chris Leary, Head of Infra Equity at OIC, LP and a Nova board member. “His combination of operating, financial and leadership experience makes him well suited to lead Nova through its next phase as we focus on operational excellence, disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation.”

“As interim CEO, I look forward to working with our employees, customers, lenders and shareholders to realize Nova’s full potential,” said Gray. “We have a strong team, a diverse fleet and supportive financial partners. Our immediate priorities are clear: exceptional customer service, operational and financial excellence, and disciplined capital allocation. By executing against those priorities, we believe Nova will be well positioned to create long-term value for all our stakeholders.”

Mike Wright, a longtime compression executive, has been appointed senior vice president of business development. A petroleum engineer by background, Wright has spent more than 20 years growing artificial lift and compression businesses. He will lead Nova’s efforts to grow with new and existing customers and to establish the company as a leader in customer satisfaction.

Jay McKenna has been appointed interim president. McKenna is a managing director at OIC, LP, one of Nova’s shareholders, and has built a career as an executive and entrepreneur in the energy industry. He will support Gray and the Nova team in driving operational excellence.

Nova operates a mixed fleet that includes traditional natural gas compression, electric compression and high-pressure gas lift (HPGL) units, allowing it to serve producers across the full production lifecycle.

Nova has grown its fleet from 40,000 horsepower at the start of 2021 to approximately 400,000 horsepower today, most recently adding Energy Gas Compression’s South Texas fleet in July 2026.

About Nova Compression

Nova Compression, LLC is an Oklahoma City-based provider of natural gas compression services to producers in Oklahoma and Texas, including the Eagle Ford and Delaware basins. With a fleet of approximately 400,000 horsepower, Nova meets producers’ gas lift, wellhead and general compression needs through contract compression, maintenance, service and repair. Learn more at nova-compression.com.

Media Contact: Kym Koch Thompson kym@kochcomm.com

data.title: Cox Enterprises Honors Environmental Leaders Driving Change in Communities
data.description:
Cox Enterprises Honors Environmental Leaders Driving Change in Communities

Cox Enterprises Honors Environmental Leaders Driving Change in Communities

PR Newswire

ATLANTA, Oct. 16, 2026

2026 Cox Conserves Heroes recognized for advancing conservation, reducing waste and inspiring environmental action 

ATLANTA, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cox Enterprises recognized David Schick, Nithya Tammana and Detroit Hives as the 2026 Cox Conserves Heroes, celebrating their efforts to drive positive environmental changes in their communities.

Since 2008, Cox Conserves Heroes has recognized more than 200 individuals and nonprofits whose environmental efforts have made a significant impact on their communities. The award criteria align with Cox Enterprises' corporate goals to save energy and water, reduce waste, and protect and restore natural habitats and species.

The winners were announced at a ceremony on Oct. 14, and each received a $30,000 grant from the James M. Cox Foundation to support an environmental nonprofit of their choice. The nonprofit winner received the Jim Kennedy Conservation Award, named in honor of Cox's Chairman Emeritus Jim Kennedy, a noted environmentalist and chairman of the James M. Cox Foundation.

"This year's Cox Conserves Heroes demonstrate the powerful role individuals and organizations play in advancing environmental sustainability in their communities," said Amit Vyas, vice president of Environmental Sustainability at Cox Enterprises. "Their efforts reflect the same principle that guides Cox's environmental strategy: meaningful progress starts with action. By recognizing these changemakers, we're celebrating solutions that strengthen communities today while helping create a more sustainable future."

Meet the Heroes
David Schick received the Groundbreaker Award in the adult category. Through his work with Precious Plastics Monterey Bay in California, David trains volunteers, students and nonprofits to transform plastic waste into durable products such as furniture while raising awareness about plastic pollution and microplastics. He has trained hundreds of people on open-source recycling equipment and partnered with students from 20 Bay Area schools, five University of California campuses, Stanford University, Loyola Marymount University and Pitzer College, as well as businesses, hospitals and environmental organizations. Through a global network of more than 450 Precious Plastics groups, David shares sustainable practices with collaborators across Africa, Asia, Europe, North America and South America, helping communities turn waste into opportunity.

Nithya Tammana is this year's Planet Protector Award recipient and winner of the youth category. At age 9, Nithya founded Save Drop in Monroe Township, New Jersey, to address the global water crisis through innovative, nature-inspired solutions that reduce water waste and improve water quality. Her invention, BioLayer, is an affordable water filter that reduces lead to non-detectable levels during testing and earned recognition in the 2026 Mott Million-Dollar Challenge and the 2026 3M Young Scientist Challenge. Through Save Drop, Nithya has reached more than 1 million people, launched more than 100 student clubs and partnered with 22 restaurants across 11 states. She also advocates for clean water policies, including writing to all 50 governors to encourage action on water conservation and safety.

Detroit Hives received the Jim Kennedy Conservation Award, named in honor of Cox Enterprises Chairman Emeritus and James M. Cox Foundation Chairman Jim Kennedy, an environmentalist who started Cox Conserves in 2007. Based in Detroit, the nonprofit transforms vacant lots into thriving green spaces that support both pollinators and local communities. The organization manages urban beehives that are home to more than 2.5 million honeybees while educating thousands of children each year about beekeeping and pollinator health. To date, Detroit Hives has revitalized more than 38 vacant lots and harvests more than 1,000 pounds of honey annually, creating spaces where environmental stewardship, education and community connection can flourish.

The second- and third-place winners in each category received $15,000 and $5,000, respectively, for the environmental nonprofit of their choice. 

 Adult Category

  • Second Place: Benjamin Miller, Indianapolis, Indiana
  • Third Place: Russell Pilegaard, Ruthton, Minnesota

Youth Category (Under 18)

  • Second Place: Brandon Lin, Hillsborough, California
  • Third Place: Sammie Vance, Fort Wayne, Indiana

Nonprofit Category

  • Second Place: Keep Golden Isles Beautiful, Golden Isles, Georgia
  • Third Place: Ocean Defenders Alliance, California and Hawaii

Building on a legacy of environmental action
Cox has long believed business success and environmental responsibility go hand in hand. Cox Enterprises has invested $3 billion in cleantech businesses and, together with the James M. Cox Foundation, contributed more than $800 million to philanthropic causes.

In 2026, the company announced plans to go further. In addition to long-established goals around water, waste and carbon, Cox expanded its environmental focus to include habitat and species, recognizing the critical role healthy ecosystems play in supporting communities, protecting natural resources and strengthening climate resilience. This broadens Cox's focus beyond impact reduction and positions the company to pursue more initiatives that actively restore and protect nature.

By 2034, the company aims to:

  • Protect and restore land and ecosystems at a scale that reflects its footprint.
  • Reduce its greenhouse gas emissions by 1 million metric tons and source 80% of electricity from renewable energy.
  • Replenish and reduce hundreds of millions of gallons of water.
  • Divert and return 1 billion pounds of post-use plastic from the environment back into the circular economy.

Learn more about our collective impact and the 2026 Cox Conserves Heroes at CoxEnterprises.com/our-impact.

About Cox Enterprises
Cox Enterprises is a global privately-held company that owns, operates and invests in businesses across multiple industries, including automotive, greenhouse agriculture, cleantech, software, outdoor recreation and journalism. Guided by its purpose to build a better future for this generation and the next, Cox's diverse family of businesses deliver solutions to address some of the world's most pressing challenges. Since its founding in 1898, Cox Enterprises has been fueled by a relentless focus on innovation and a deep commitment to people, the planet and progress. To learn more about Cox's history and how it's shaping what's next, visit CoxEnterprises.com.

About the James M. Cox Foundation
The James M. Cox Foundation is named in honor of Cox Enterprises' founder and provides funding for capital campaigns and special projects in communities where the company operates. The Foundation concentrates its community support in several areas, including biodiversity, conservation and environment, early childhood education, health, and empowering families and individuals for success.

data.title: DEWALT and August Robotics' Downward Drilling Robot Named to TIME's Best Inventions of 2026
data.description:
DEWALT and August Robotics' Downward Drilling Robot Named to TIME's Best Inventions of 2026

DEWALT and August Robotics' Downward Drilling Robot Named to TIME's Best Inventions of 2026

PR Newswire

TOWSON, Md., Oct. 16, 2026
  • DALE™, the world's first fleet-capable downward drilling robot, recognized in the Robotics category for advancing speed, precision, and safety in data center construction
  • Robot selected by TIME editors as one of 300 extraordinary innovations changing how we live, work, play, and think about what's possible
  • Developed in collaboration with August Robotics, DALE drills at speeds up to 10 times faster than traditional methods, reduced project timelines by more than 300 weeks across 44 data center construction phases, and achieved over 99% accuracy drilling more than 385,000 holes

TOWSON, Md., Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- DEWALT, a Stanley Black & Decker brand renowned for relentless innovation on the jobsite, today announced that DALE, its autonomous downward drilling robot developed in collaboration with global mobile robotics leader August Robotics, has been named to TIME's Best Inventions of 2026 list in the Robotics category. Nominated and evaluated by TIME editors and correspondents around the world, the winning 300 innovations were selected based on originality, efficacy, ambition, and impact.

Designed to dramatically improve how concrete drilling is performed, DALE is helping redefine data center construction at a time when demand for new computing capacity continues to accelerate. To date, on live data center jobsites, DALE has achieved drilling speeds up to 10 times faster than conventional methods, helped reduce project timelines by more than 300 weeks across 44 phases of data center construction, and delivered over 99% accuracy across more than 385,000 holes.

"We are honored that TIME has recognized DALE as one of the Best Inventions of 2026. DALE is an example of DEWALT's drive to deliver hyper-focused innovation to our end users and how advanced technology can be applied in a practical, results-driven way," said Bill Beck, President, Tools & Outdoor, Stanley Black & Decker. "This is about bringing new capability to the jobsite and helping customers meet rising demands with greater productivity and improved safety."

After earning strong industry attention earlier this year and entering the market as a breakthrough solution optimized for data center construction, DALE continues to demonstrate how advanced automation can improve execution on large-scale infrastructure projects. Its recognition by TIME further validates the role robotics can play in helping customers increase output, simplify workflows, boost safety, and support the pace of modern building.

See the full list of TIME's Best Inventions of 2026 at: ti.me/best-inventions. 

To learn more about the robot and DEWALT's industry-leading solutions for jobsite professionals, visit www.dewalt.com.

For information on August Robotics and its autonomous mobile robotics solutions for construction, visit www.augustrobotics.com.

About DEWALT
DEWALT, a Stanley Black & Decker brand, celebrates 100 years in business by continuing to provide our customers with total jobsite and outdoor solutions. By applying its latest technology to the challenges of today's skilled trades, DEWALT is leading the charge for the jobsite of the future and is pioneering the next generation of tools, outdoor equipment and forward-looking technologies. DEWALT products. GUARANTEED TOUGH®. For more information, visit www.dewalt.com or follow DEWALT on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.

About Stanley Black & Decker
Founded in 1843 and headquartered in the USA, Stanley Black & Decker (NYSE: SWK) is a worldwide leader in Tools and Outdoor, operating manufacturing facilities globally. The Company's approximately 41,000 employees produce innovative end-user inspired power tools, hand tools, storage, digital jobsite solutions, outdoor and lifestyle products, and engineered fasteners to support the world's builders, tradespeople and DIYers. The Company's world class portfolio of trusted brands includes DEWALT®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, BLACK+DECKER®, and Cub Cadet®. To learn more visit: www.stanleyblackanddecker.com or follow Stanley Black & Decker on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and X.

About August Robotics
August Robotics is a leading international mobile robotics company that builds robots to improve lives and boost productivity by automating dirty, dangerous and dull jobs. Founded in 2017, August Robotics has expanded worldwide and partners with market leaders to develop new robotic applications across industries including construction, commercial and industrial fit-outs, and exhibitions. For more information, visit www.augustrobotics.com, or follow August Robotics on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

data.title: OUTKICK POSTS STRONG GROWTH IN Q3 2026
data.description:
OUTKICK POSTS STRONG GROWTH IN Q3 2026

OUTKICK POSTS STRONG GROWTH IN Q3 2026

PR Newswire

NEW YORK, Oct. 16, 2026

 The Platform Also Saw Year Over Year Growth in September

NEW YORK, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- National multimedia sports platform OutKick completes Q3 2026 with significant growth across all categories. The platform finished with 12.2 million average monthly desktop and mobile unique visitors, up 40% versus the prior quarter and up 149% versus the prior year quarter, 190 million total multiplatform views, up 56% versus the prior quarter and up 187% versus the prior year quarter, and 201 million total multiplatform minutes, up 29% versus the prior quarter and up 196% versus the prior year quarter, according to Comscore.*

Additionally, OutKick in September 2026 delivered 12.8 million total desktop and mobile unique visitors, up 188% versus the prior year, 64 million multiplatform views, up 192% versus the prior year, and 62 million total multiplatform minutes, up 213% versus the prior year, according to Comscore.

In commenting on the digital performance, OutKick's senior vice president and managing editor Gary Schreier said, "OutKick's quarterly numbers reflect the platform's continued growth and influence across sports and culture. Throughout the quarter, OutKick broke sport industry news involving ESPN, drove the conversation around Sophie Cunningham, and delivered on-the-ground coverage for college football and the NFL. This speaks to OutKick's commitment to providing authentic and in-depth stories shaping the sports landscape." 

On Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), and Instagram in Q3 2026, OutKick saw over 3 million social actions, up 58% versus the prior quarter and over 27.3 million total video views, up 22% versus the prior quarter on Facebook, X and YouTube, according to ComscoreSocial.*** 

In September, OutKick also announced the signing of Matt Calkins, the former Seattle Times sports columnist, who joined the platform to cover sports and culture. 

*Source: Comscore Media Metrix® Multi-Platform, September 2026, Desktop and Mobile, US.

**Source: Comscore Media Metrix® Multi-Platform, September 2026, Total Digital Population, US

***Source: Comscore Social, Metrics & Trends, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, September 2026, Report Date: 10/15/2026. Custom-Defined List including Outkick.

About OutKick
OutKick is one of the fastest growing national multimedia platforms that produces and distributes engaging content at the intersection of sports, sports culture, pop culture, and news. OutKick's industry recognized stable of reporters, hosts and contributors are accessible on FoxNews.com/OutKick as well as across video livestreams, social media, podcasts, and radio, reaching tens of millions of fans each month. Owned by Fox Corporation, OutKick was originally founded by Clay Travis. For more information, please visit FoxNews.com/OutKick.

Fortune Media and Great Place To Work name Invisors to 2026 Best Workplaces in Technology list, ranking no. 11

PR Newswire

ATLANTA, Oct. 16, 2026

ATLANTA, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Great Place To Work® and Fortune magazine have selected Invisors for the 2026 Fortune Best Workplaces in Technology™ List. This is Invisors' 3rd time being named to this prestigious list, this year coming in at no. 11.

 "Being recognized as a Best Workplace in Technology reflects that curiosity and the people who bring it to life every day."

The Best Workplaces in Technology award is based on analysis of survey responses from nearly 144,000 employees from Great Place To Work Certified™ companies in the tech industry.

"Working in technology means there is always something new to learn, rethink or improve and that mindset is a big part of what makes Invisors unique," shares Travis Brody, Managing Partner at Invisors. "Our people aren't simply keeping pace with changes in technology—they're continually exploring what those changes mean for our clients and how we can put them to work in practical ways. Being recognized as a Best Workplace in Technology reflects that curiosity and the people who bring it to life every day."

The Best Workplaces in Technology list is highly competitive. Survey responses reflect a comprehensive picture of the workplace experience. Honorees were selected based on their ability to offer positive outcomes for employees regardless of job role, work status or other demographic identifier.

"Congratulations to the Fortune Best Workplaces in Technology," says Michael C. Bush, CEO of Great Place To Work. "People are at the heart of work in every industry and technology is no exception. These companies show how delivering for your people drives financial performance and turns fear of the future into the confidence to win."

Read about the various recognitions Invisors has received this year from Great Place to Work across the US and UK at https://www.invisors.com/news.

About Invisors

As a certified Workday Services Partner, Invisors helps customers utilize their organizational data to make better-informed business decisions through the deployment of Workday. We believe the most important measure of our team's success is our client's ability to achieve their big-picture vision. From initial deployments to ongoing projects, we are focused on elevating perspectives + transforming results. Learn more by visiting invisors.com.

About the Fortune Best Workplaces in Technology List

Great Place To Work selected the 2026 Best Workplaces in Technology by analyzing confidential survey responses from more than 1.3 million employees in the U.S., representing the experiences of over 7.3 million employees in 2025 and 2026. Of those responses, nearly 144,000 came from employees at Great Place To Work Certified companies in the technology industry and this ranking is based on that feedback. Companies with 10 to 999 employees competed in the small and medium category. Companies with 1,000 or more employees were considered for the large category.

About Great Place To Work

As the global authority on workplace culture, Great Place To Work, a UKG company, brings 30 years of groundbreaking research and data to help every place become a great place to work for all. Its proprietary platform and Great Place To Work Model help companies evaluate the experience of every employee, with exemplary workplaces becoming Great Place To Work Certified and receiving recognition on a coveted Best Workplaces list.

About Fortune

Fortune upholds a legacy of award-winning writing and trusted reporting for executives who want to make business better. Independently owned, with a global perspective and digital agility, Fortune tells the stories of a new generation of innovators, builders and risk takers. Online and in print, Fortune measures corporate performance through rigorous benchmarks and holds companies accountable. Fortune creates communities by convening true thought leaders and iconoclasts — those who shape industry, commerce and society — through powerful and prestigious lists, events and conferences, such as the iconic Fortune 500, the CEO Initiative and Most Powerful Women. For more information, visit fortune.com.
